package_artifacts.integration: src/pd/deadline.rs: Watcher::new, start, serial watch worker; timer duration starts before bounded admission; timeout callback, explicit done, parent/caller cancellation and zero-capacity channel semantics retained.

source_go_deadline_TestWatcher ports all TestWatcher assertions; TestMain goleak is covered by retained worker joins, last-owner retirement and callback release tests. Additional deterministic queue/zero/blocked-admission cases cover all production branches.

dependency_decisions.native: Existing async_util::Cancellation, tokio::time::Instant/sleep_until, bounded serial queue with watch notifications. Rust ownership retains and joins the worker; final handle drop cancels it. Negative Go time.Duration has the same immediate-expiry behavior represented by Duration::ZERO. The shared Cancellation adapter now registers its waiter before checking the atomic state; a deterministic fail-before regression proves the eliminated lost-wakeup window.

Reviewed both artifacts. Adapter uses an absolute monotonic deadline instead of recreating Go timer pooling. No stale timer event can survive completion/reset; queued timers retain original start time. This does not claim a separate timerutil package port.
Existing log crate emits watcher start/expiry/exit with source. No new logging owner/dependency.
